I am a woman with no schooling, farming millet on my small plot here in the North East. The rains are short and the soil is tired, but fertilizer is expensive and I must be careful with what little money I have. I will put a small amount of NPK if I can get it from the agro-dealer, and spread the goat and chicken manure from my compound on the plot before planting. I will use my own millet seed that I saved from last year, like my mother did, and I will intercrop with cowpea as always. My children and I will do most of the work, but at weeding time I may call one or two people to help for a few days.
